interpretation: Scenario groups are contract checks, not independent samples or a quality score. Every scenario runs at 360x844 and 1440x1000 in isolated Chromium and WebKit contexts. A grouped scenario passes only when all its required observations pass. Visual design is reviewed separately from screenshots. No criteria may be added after candidates are inspected; runner bug fixes must be logged.

landing.name: Useful factual content and valid navigation
landing.criteria: Fictional demonstration, named product and all supplied capabilities, three-step workflow, two pricing plans, four FAQs, working CTA and section links, no external resource fetches or invented quantified social proof.

landing.name: Mobile navigation lifecycle
landing.criteria: Open/close synchronizes aria-expanded; visible menu links target sections; Escape closes and restores toggle focus; link selection closes; desktop navigation remains reachable.

landing.name: Feature tab state and keyboard
landing.criteria: All three tabs have role=tab and matching tabpanels, one visible selected panel; click and arrow-key changes synchronize selected state and display distinct content.

landing.name: Billing round trip
landing.criteria: Monthly 12/29 per month; yearly 108/264 per year; returning restores monthly values and visible period labels.

landing.name: Native FAQ interactions and supplied answers
landing.criteria: Exactly four details/summary entries, individually operable with meaningful answer content consistent with supplied local-storage/export/backup/cancellation facts.

landing.name: No-JavaScript fallback
landing.criteria: Product content, pricing and section navigation remain visible and useful with JavaScript disabled.

landing.name: Responsive rendering, keyboard names and reduced motion
landing.criteria: No horizontal document overflow, nonzero main content and loaded local illustration/resources, meaningful accessible names for visible controls, and no active long nonessential animation under prefers-reduced-motion. Screenshots support separate design review.

app.name: Empty-storage initialization
app.criteria: At least six valid unique records, two projects and every status; matching rendered cards and useful fictional/local-only framing.

app.name: Create/edit and persistence
app.criteria: Create trims fields and deduplicates tags case-insensitively, generates a unique ID; edit updates only target; both persist across reload.

app.name: Status update preserves other records
app.criteria: Native status select changes only target status, displays new value and survives reload.

app.name: Delete and exact undo
app.criteria: Delete removes target from UI/storage; visible undo restores exact record and persists on reload.

app.name: Combined search and filters
app.criteria: Case-insensitive title/project/tag search; status/project/priority filters intersect; filtered cards match exactly; no-result state and visible total/matching count.

app.name: Form validation and modal keyboard lifecycle
app.criteria: Blank and overlong text and invalid calendar date cannot mutate board; visible feedback; modal form closes on Escape and returns focus when applicable.

app.name: Full export and confirmed import round trip
app.criteria: Export includes filtered-out tasks; valid replacement requires explicit confirmation, replaces records atomically and persists on reload.

app.name: Reject malformed/unsupported import atomically
app.criteria: Malformed JSON, wrong schema and invalid enum leave the exact stored board unchanged with visible error.

app.name: Reject duplicate IDs and invalid date atomically
app.criteria: Duplicate IDs, non-calendar dates and overlong task text each leave the prior board unchanged with visible error.

app.name: Import size boundary
app.criteria: Files exceeding 1 MiB are rejected without replacement and with visible error.

app.name: Imported hostile text remains text
app.criteria: Valid confirmed record containing HTML-shaped title/project/tags displays literal text without executing script or injecting event-bearing elements.

app.name: Corrupt storage recovery
app.criteria: Exact corrupt bytes survive startup; visible recovery notice; original bytes can be downloaded; reset requires explicit confirmation.

app.name: Storage write failure keeps work recoverable
app.criteria: Thrown writes preserve persisted board, visibly report unsaved/storage failure, and retain attempted work in memory or form.

app.name: Cross-tab stale-write protection
app.criteria: Real second-tab storage event prompts visible conflict/reload notice and prevents silent overwrite of newer state; safe documented reconciliation accepted for manual review.

app.name: Responsive rendering and accessible controls
app.criteria: No horizontal overflow, useful content and meaningful accessible names for controls at both widths; screenshots support separate qualitative design review.

app.name: No-JavaScript notice and reduced motion
app.criteria: Useful visible no-JavaScript message; reduced-motion context has no active long nonessential animation.

limits: No model judge is used by this oracle.
The browser oracle checks supplied contracts, not universal security, correctness or visual quality.
Visual design and possible invented claims require a separate blinded review of captured artifacts.
A runner infrastructure error is distinct from a failed product scenario and must not count as a product failure.
